name: Temecula
blurb: Wine country living, master-planned neighborhoods, strong schools, and a lifestyle draw that keeps buyer demand resilient year-round.
buyerAngle: Compare Pechanga-area estates, older charmers, and newer tracts — inventory and HOA rules vary block by block.
sellerAngle: Presentation and pricing against active comps matter here. Lifestyle photos and timing around seasonal demand help maximize exposure.

name: Murrieta
blurb: Family-oriented communities, parks, and freeway access — a frequent choice for buyers who want space without losing convenience.
buyerAngle: Focus on school boundaries, lot size, and commute patterns toward OC and San Diego corridors.
sellerAngle: Clean condition and competitive pricing win in Murrieta. Strategic prep often beats sitting on market.

name: Orange County
blurb: Coastal-adjacent and inland OC markets with diverse price points — from first move-up homes to established neighborhood estates.
buyerAngle: Competition can be sharp. Pre-approval, offer strategy, and local nuance separate winning bids from also-rans.
sellerAngle: OC buyers are informed. Pricing, staging, and professional marketing protect your equity.

name: Hacienda Heights
blurb: Established hillside and valley neighborhoods with strong community roots — convenient to the 60 corridor and San Gabriel Valley amenities.
buyerAngle: Compare views, lot size, school options, and commute access toward LA and OC. Inventory and condition vary street by street.
sellerAngle: Presentation and accurate pricing against local comps matter. Highlight outdoor living, updates, and neighborhood appeal.
